name: trust-gate-mcp
description: Tamper-evident receipts for consequential agent actions, plus a two-phase gate that returns ALLOW, DENY or ESCALATE from a read-only allowlist and signs the verdict. Integrity is verifiable offline from the certificate alone; pin the Ed25519 key id to check who signed.

OAO_RECEIPT_KEY.description: Path to the persistent Ed25519 signing key (the stdio default keeps one under ~/.openagentontology). In a container, mount a volume here: without one the key changes on every restart, so receipts signed earlier still verify from their own certificate but a pinned kid stops matching new ones.

TRUST_GATE_REQUIRE_PQ.description: Require at least one verified post-quantum signature on verify. Default ON. Only 0, false, no or off turn it off. It shows a post-quantum signature is present and valid, not whose key made it. OAO_REQUIRE_PQ is read when this one is empty.

TRUST_GATE_BEARER_TOKEN.description: If set, the HTTP transport requires this bearer token. Unset means no auth, which is fine for stdio/local use and not for a public HTTP deployment.

TRUST_GATE_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated CORS allowlist for the HTTP transport. Applies only when TRUST_GATE_BEARER_TOKEN is set; without a token the transport allows any origin.

TRUST_GATE_CHANNELS.description: Extra ?via= labels the HTTP attribution counter records (comma separated). Optional.

TRUST_GATE_FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS.description: Proxy addresses whose X-Forwarded-For header is trusted for rate limiting. Set it to your proxy; the default trusts any, so clients can choose their own identity.

tools.name: mint_receipt_for_record_change
tools.description: Mint a receipt for one CRM record change. Old and new values are SHA-256 hashed (unsalted, so a low-entropy value can be guessed from its hash).

arguments.object_type: The kind of record changed (e.g. contact, deal)
arguments.changed_by_agent: The agent that made the change

tools.name: audit_my_agent_inventory
tools.description: Rank a CALLER-PROVIDED list of MCP tools by worst-regret if they act (a name-based heuristic that weights a name's first word most). Read-only: mints no receipt. Cannot auto-discover other servers.

arguments.inventory: List of {server, tool, capability} entries supplied by the caller

tools.name: mint_action_receipt
tools.description: Mint a receipt for any consequential agent action. Optional attestation values are caller claims: limited to safe characters, signed, not verified. Decisions containing a gate verdict word are reserved for gate_decision.

arguments.decision: Optional decision label (not a gate verdict word)
arguments.decision_model: Optional: the LLM model behind the decision (self-reported)

tools.name: verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify a receipt from the certificate alone (offline). ok=true means unchanged since signing, signed, kid consistent with the embedded key, and (in the default PQ-required mode) at least one post-quantum signature verified. Unsigned receipts fail. It does not prove who signed: pass expected_kid to pin the signer's Ed25519 key; a pin counts only when that key's own signature verifies (signer_pinned). The post-quantum keys are not covered by the kid.

arguments.expected_kid: Optional kid of the key you trust; ok is false unless the receipt's key matches

tools.name: gate_decision
tools.description: Two-phase decision gate with a real verdict. PREVIEW returns ALLOW, DENY or ESCALATE with the risk tier and reasons, without acting; COMMIT re-evaluates the inputs and mints a signed receipt for the verdict. Only ALLOW returns a GRANTED permit. Applies only to actions routed through it.

arguments.preview_id: Required on COMMIT — ties the commit to its preview
arguments.decision_model: Optional attestation: the LLM model behind the decision

tools.name: check_egress
tools.description: Flag sensitive markers in a data sample: NO_MARKERS_FOUND / INTERNAL / CONFIDENTIAL / RESTRICTED. Credential-shaped values and personal identifiers are RESTRICTED and set blocked=true; this tool cannot block anything itself and NO_MARKERS_FOUND is not clearance to send. Returns classification, retention info and a receipt.

tools.name: run_exit_drill
tools.description: Vendor exit-readiness drill: checks the local signing key (names the post-quantum backend) and a local model host. Informational; it signs one receipt, which creates the signing key on a host that has none yet.

security.auditTrail: Every minted receipt is signed with Ed25519, plus ML-DSA-65 when the post-quantum backend is available and carries a 128-bit kid derived from its Ed25519 key. A verifier can check offline that the receipt is unchanged, signed and consistent with its kid, and can pin the kid it trusts; a pin counts only when the Ed25519 signature verifies. Without a pin, a valid result shows only that whoever holds the embedded keys signed these bytes.

novel_capabilities: Agent-action receipts signed with a hybrid classical + lattice scheme (default lattice backend is unhardened)
Offline verification of integrity from the certificate alone, with optional pinning of the Ed25519 key id
Two-phase PREVIEW to COMMIT gate that returns ALLOW, DENY or ESCALATE from a read-only allowlist and signs the verdict
